svg.title: Filters redistribute the same scene
svg.desc: No filter: 50% dark · full scale; Yellow (#8): 49% dark · full scale; Orange (#21): 48% dark · full scale; Red (#25): 41% dark · full scale; Deep red (#29): 35% dark · full scale; Green (#58): 50% dark · full scale; Blue (#47): 54% dark · no paper white
svg.text: Share of the frame in each zone. Every row shares one scale; the tallest column in each row is labelled.
